title: Lifted Model Construction under Approximate Commutativity
abstract: arXiv:2608.24713v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Lifted inference algorithms enable scalable probabilistic inference even for large object domains by leveraging the indistinguishability of objects in a probability distribution. An essential prerequisite for constructing a lifted representation is to identify commutative factors, i.e., functions whose output values are invariant under permutations of a subset of their input values, in a potential-based factorisation. In practice, however, parameters learned from data inevitably deviate even if associated objects are indistinguishable, causing their corresponding factors to be only approximately commutative instead of being exactly commutative. We address this problem by introducing the concept of {\epsilon}-commutativity, a relaxation of commutativity where output values are only approximately invariant under permutations of input values. Specifically, we show how {\epsilon}-commutativity can be exploited for lifted model construction,

translated_title: 近似交换性下的提升模型构建
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24713v1 公告类型：新  摘要：提升推理算法通过利用概率分布中对象的不可区分性，即使对于大型对象域也能实现可扩展的概率推理。构建提升表示的一个基本前提是在基于势的因子分解中识别交换因子，即其输出值在其输入值子集的排列下不变的函数。然而，在实践中，即使关联对象不可区分，从数据中学习到的参数也难免会偏离，导致相应的因子仅近似交换而非精确交换。我们通过引入{\epsilon}-交换性的概念来解决这个问题，这是交换性的一种松弛，其中输出值在输入值排列下仅近似不变。具体来说，我们展示了如何利用{\epsilon}-交换性进行提升模型构建。
tldr: 本文提出近似交换性概念，使提升模型构建在参数偏差下仍能有效进行，扩展了提升推理的适用性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of approximate commutativity, enabling lifted model construction to remain effective under parameter deviations, thereby extending the applicability of lifted inference.
